```{r load libraries, message=FALSE}

```


```{r}
inputdir <- "./results/1_MapMyCells/"
outdir <- "./results/figures/"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Import main obj and markers
```{r}
seurat_obj <- readRDS(file = paste0(inputdir,"compiled_area_norm_all_clusters_MMC.rds"))
```

```{r}
# markers linked to cell cluster calls
#### cluster numbers from clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2 ident ####
markers <- read.csv("./data/markers_refined.csv")

features_plot <- na.omit(unique(markers$marker))
```

# Figs

## DotPlot

```{r}
# clusters must be ordered
seurat_obj$clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2 <- factor(seurat_obj$clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2, 
                                                  levels = sort(unique(seurat_obj$clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2)))

p1 <- DotPlot(seurat_obj, 
              features = features_plot,
              group.by = "clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2",
              assay = "AreaNorm",
              cols = c("#D55E00", "#0072B2")) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14, angle = 45, hjust=1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") + 
  guides(size  = guide_legend(title = "% expression"), # shortening titles
         color = guide_colorbar(title = "Avg. expression"))

ggsave(paste0(outdir,"markers_dotplot.pdf"), p1, width = 9, height = 10, units = "in")
```

## Heatmap of MMC annotations

```{r}
# Plots the most prevalent class from the MMC subclass category:

clust_col <- "clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2"
sub_col   <- "subclass_name"                  # MapMyCells subclass column
md        <- seurat_obj@meta.data

## composition: % of each subclass within the clusters ##
comp <- md %>%
  count(cluster = .data[[clust_col]], subclass = .data[[sub_col]], name = "n") %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

## lump subclasses that never reach 10% in any cluster into "other"
keep <- comp %>% group_by(subclass) %>% summarise(mx = max(prop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(mx >= 0.05) %>% pull(subclass) # cutoff for classes to be "other" 
comp <- comp %>%
  mutate(subclass = ifelse(subclass %in% keep, subclass, "other")) %>%
  group_by(cluster, subclass) %>% summarise(prop = sum(prop), .groups = "drop")

## order axes: clusters 1-34; subclasses alphabetical with "other" last
comp$cluster  <- factor(comp$cluster, levels = 1:34)
sub_levels    <- sort(setdiff(unique(comp$subclass), "other"))
comp$subclass <- factor(comp$subclass, levels = c("other", rev(sub_levels)))

## label text: only show >=10%, and pick a legible colors per tile
comp <- comp %>%
  mutate(lab      = ifelse(prop >= 0.10, round(prop * 100), NA),
         txt_col  = ifelse(prop >= 0.50, "white", "grey10"))

## heatmap ##
p1 <- ggplot(comp, aes(cluster, subclass, fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "grey92") +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab, colour = txt_col), size = 4.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1,
                       labels = scales::percent, name = "% of cluster",
                       limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "BANKSY cluster", y = "MapMyCells subclass") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid   = element_blank(),
        axis.title   = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 12))

ggsave(paste0(outdir, "mmc_composition_heatmap.pdf"),
       width = 14, height = 8, limitsize = FALSE)
```

## Annotated UMAP

```{r}
# add cell calls to the seurat obj

# Create one row per peak_cluster
cluster_map <- markers %>%
  select(peak_cluster, cell_type) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(peak_cluster = as.character(peak_cluster))

celltype_vector <- setNames(cluster_map$cell_type, cluster_map$peak_cluster)

# Add annotation to Seurat metadata
seurat_obj$CellType <- unname(celltype_vector[as.character(seurat_obj$clust_BSKY_l0.0_k15_d30_r1.2)])

# save annotated obj

saveRDS(seurat_obj,paste0(outdir,"seurat_area_norm_annotated.rds"))
```
